{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} [[File:Soleil.png|thumb|250px|Soleil]] '''Soleil''' (Japanese: '''ハルヒ''' ''Haruhi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN079|Night and Day, You are the Ones!]]''. She is the granddaughter of [[Helia]] and a descendant of [[Sorin and Luno|Sorin]], the first liege of [[Eclipse Castle]]. Helia was the present day liege, until she decided to pass down the title to Soleil. Soleil is a [[doppelgänger]] of [[Chloe]]. Soleil first appeared near a sundial alongside her {{p|Espeon}} and {{p|Umbreon}} when her Espeon sensed [[Chloe's Eevee]] was about to fall off a cliff. Once Espeon saved Eevee, Soleil met Chloe and was surprised that they looked alike. After meeting up with {{Ash}} and [[Goh]], Soleil swapped clothes with Chloe and met up with Heila. Soleil went to become the liege of Eclipse Castle, only for the ceremony to be interrupted by [[Ilunas]], who had unknowingly kidnapped Chloe instead of Soleil. Soleil battled Ilunas alongside Chloe and was able to defeat him. Soleil subsequently became liege of Eclipse Castle, but upon learning of Soleil's identity, convinced him to change his ways and have him assist her in her duties as liege. She reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN089|The Gates of Warp!]]'', ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'', and ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Soleil reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Soleil's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Soleil |pkmn=Espeon ♀ and Umbreon ♂ |stage1=Eevee (×2) |type1=Psychic |type2=Dark |img=Soleil Eevee.png |cap=Soleil's Espeon (right) and Umbreon (left) as Eevee |img2=Soleil Espeon Umbreon.png |cap2=Soleil's Espeon and Umbreon |epnum=JN079 |epname=Night and Day, You are the Ones! |desc={{p|Espeon}} and {{p|Umbreon}} are Soleil's only known Pokémon. Soleil first had them as {{p|Eevee}}, where her female Eevee evolved into Espeon after she tripped and fell on top of her during the day. The following night, her male Eevee evolved into Umbreon battling a {{p|Crobat}} at night while protecting Soleil and Espeon. In the present, Espeon rescued [[Chloe's Eevee]] from falling off a cliff. Espeon and Umbreon were used to battle [[Ilunas]]'s Pokémon alongside Eevee and were able to take them down. As confirmed by [[List of Pokémon with gender differences|gender differences]] as an Eevee, Espeon is confirmed to be female, while Umbreon is confirmed to be male. They reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'' and ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Espeon and Umbreon reappeared in a fantasy alongside Soleil. Espeon's known moves are {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Wish}}, and {{m|Reflect}}.
